queue_policy: One track request at a time. Wait for no Creating/Generating indicator, download complete audio and verify decode before requesting the next track. An error does not imply generation stopped: inspect persisted results first; never automatically resend.

validation.browserFlow: Main menu -> single player -> pause (timer stays at 00:05) -> settings -> pause -> main menu; no console errors or warnings

deployment.publicCheck: Main menu loaded silently; DOM script matches release bundle; no console errors or warnings
